name: Download an image and post it to Instagram

parameters.content:
## Download an image and post it to Instagram

### Who's it for

Anyone who wants a simple, repeatable way to post to Instagram.

### How it works

1. Runs when you click Execute Workflow.
2. Calls an external API over HTTP (media generation, status polling, or download).
3. Publishes a post to Instagram via the SocialRobot API.

### How to set up

- [ ] Install the SocialRobot community node, then create an API key at [socialrobot.io](https://socialrobot.io) (Scheduler -> API Keys) and connect your SocialRobot API credential.
- [ ] Connect your Replicate account in the HTTP Request nodes (media generation, status checks, and download).
- [ ] Select your connected account in each Publish node.
- [ ] Make sure an upstream node provides the image as binary data (for example an HTTP Request node).

### Requirements

- A [SocialRobot](https://socialrobot.io) account with connected social channels and an API key.
- An upstream node that provides the image as binary data (for example an HTTP Request node).

## Fetch media

Downloads the image from a URL into binary data for the post.

## Publish to Instagram

Publishes the content to Instagram.

parameters.caption: Posted straight from binary data, no upload URL step needed.
